## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 424 image captures during April 2024. Capture activity was maintained throughout the reporting period, with the recorded total providing the basis for the image-quality and grading measures below. The activity record has been reviewed for this report, and no additional operational issues were identified in the information supplied.

## Image quality

Of the 424 captures, 29 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 6.8 per cent. Ungradable images could not be used for a grading outcome and are reported separately from images that proceeded to assessment. The result should continue to be monitored through routine site review, with attention to image capture and submission processes.

## Grading

A total of 117 results were recorded as referable. The median lag for grading was 2. This indicates the central grading turnaround recorded for the reporting period. The site report records no new equipment faults raised during April 2024. Overall, the available figures provide a concise summary of activity, image quality, referable outcomes, and grading timeliness at West Gate Eye Clinic.
